base_model: google/gemma-4-E4B-it (Gemma terms, commercial use allowed with the policy)
method: QLoRA, 4-bit base, LoRA rank on attention and MLP projections, 5,701,632 trainable parameters of 7,946,802,464 (0.072 %)
data: 507 synthetic care conversations generated by the base model from the care context and kept by the product's own rules (600 generated, 93 dropped); 50 held-out prompts; no public dialogue dataset (docs/DATASETS.md)

attempts.outcome: failed in training: tokenizer returned a BatchEncoding where a tensor was expected
failed: CUDA out of memory while preparing the 4-bit model for training
attempts.fix: device map balanced over the two T4s, no fp32 cast, gradient checkpointing, max length 384

attempts.outcome: failed: PEFT refused the model's clippable linear layers
attempts.fix: target modules named by a regular expression ending in .linear

attempts.merge: merged weights written; llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf failed reading the re-saved tokenizer (a list where a dict was expected)
attempts.output_files: adapter/ (adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors, tokenizer files) in the private notebook output

decision: The fine-tuned model did not beat the base model: the rule pass rate on the 50 held-out prompts went from 0.94 to 0.92 and the training loss did not fall (0.321 to 0.369 over 457 steps). The product keeps the base models chosen in phase 4 (docs/MODEL_CHOICE.md). The adapter stays in the private notebook output and is not shipped, uploaded or used.

gpu_time.how_estimated: attempt 4 from the script's own timings (generation, training, two evaluations of about five minutes, merge and the failed conversion of about fifteen minutes); attempts 1 to 3 each ran the generation (about 30 minutes) and failed within minutes of it; the notebook session clocks were not readable from this machine
